annotations.title: Meta business portfolio people and asset access

description: Agency setup on Meta Business Manager, for the person who connected Meta. action list_businesses (default): the business portfolios on this login. list_people: a business's people, system users and pending invitations, with the user ids the assign actions take. invite (email, role) / cancel_invite (invitationId) / remove_person (userId). person_assets: the ad accounts and Pages one person can reach, with tasks. list_ad_account_people, assign_ad_account, unassign_ad_account (adAccountId, userId, tasks MANAGE / ADVERTISE / ANALYZE / DRAFT). list_page_people, assign_page, unassign_page (pageId, userId, tasks MANAGE / CREATE_CONTENT / MODERATE / MESSAGING / ADVERTISE / ANALYZE). An assignment replaces the person's tasks on that asset. Removing access, narrowing tasks and inviting an ADMIN need confirm:true after the user agrees. Read back from Meta. Free.

adAccountId.description: ad account the business owns or was shared

pageId.description: Page the business owns or was shared

tasks.description: tasks to give on that asset
